entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: That worn-out house turned into quite[n]a magnificent place...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: What's with these decorations though?[n]Talk about bad taste.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Y'know, we were luck the Nav even[n]responded to what we were talkin'[n]about. I was ready to go home.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sheesh, I feel stupid for thinking[n]Madarame could be a nice person...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: These people'll lie about anything and[n]not feel bad about it.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You shoulda known that from[n]Kamoshida, right?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: ...It's quiet in here. Almost eerily so.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: After all those freakin' people were[n]outside too...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, take a look at this.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's a name... Think it's the artist?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Hey, all the paintings in here are of[n]people...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Dude, you think these are all Madarame's[n]students?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: You might actually be onto something,[n]Skull.
